sn20.6:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā sikkhitā kahatatthā katūpāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu.
sn20.6:1.4: “ahaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ daḷhadhammānaṃ dhanuggahānaṃ sikkhitānaṃ katabhatthānaṃ katūpāsanānaṃ catuddisā kaṇḍe khitte appatiṭṭhite paṭhaviyaṃ gahetvā āharissāmī”ti.
sn20.6:1.6: javano puriso paramena javena samannāgatoti alaṃ vacanāyāti?
sn20.6:2.1: ekassa cepi bhante, daḷhadhammassa dhanuggahassa sikkhitassa katahatthassa katūpāsanassa kaṇḍaṃ khittaṃ appatiṭṭhitaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ gahetvā āhareyya,
sn20.6:2.2: javano puriso paramena javena samannāgatoti alaṃ vacanāya. kopanavādo catunnaṃ daḷhadhammānaṃ dhanuggahānaṃ sikkhitānaṃ katahatthānaṃ katūpāsanānanti.
sn20.6:3.1: yathā ca bhikkhave, tassa purisassa javo yathā ca candimasuriyānaṃ javo tato sīghataro.
sn20.6:3.2: yathā ca bhikkhave, tassa purisassa javo, yathā ca candimasuriyānaṃ javo, yathā ca yā devatā candimasuriyānaṃ purato dhāvanti, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ javo tato sīghataro. yathā ca bhikkhave, tassa purisassa javo, yathā ca candimasuriyānaṃ javo, yathā ca yā devatā candimasuriyānaṃ purato dhāvanti tāsaṃ devatānaṃ javo, tato sīghataraṃ āyusaṅkhārā khīyanti.
